description: This file contains client-side script for the 'Bank Reconciliation Tool' doctype in ERPNext. It manages UI interactions, including setting queries, handling button actions, updating balances, rendering charts and data tables, and coordinating other client-side logic for bank reconciliation processes.

classes.name: NumberCardManager
classes.description: Manages numeric display cards in the bank reconciliation UI.

classes.name: DataTableManager
classes.description: Handles data table rendering and management for bank reconciliation transactions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the form, sets query filters for bank account selection.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, loads necessary scripts, and triggers reconciliation tool creation.

methods.name: after_save
methods.description: Triggers the creation of the reconciliation tool after saving the form.

methods.name: bank_account
methods.description: Fetches related account and currency info when bank account field changes.

methods.name: bank_statement_from_date
methods.description: Triggers balance calculations when the statement start date changes.

methods.name: make_reconciliation_tool
methods.description: Builds the reconciliation UI components based on current form data.

methods.name: get_account_opening_balance
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the opening balance for the selected bank account.

methods.name: get_cleared_balance
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the cleared balance up to a specified date.

methods.name: render_chart
methods.description: Renders balance charts in the reconciliation UI.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Render data tables for bank transactions based on current filters.
